newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokkaido Takushoku bank bid-only on merger plans.
newsitem.headline: Hokkaido Takushoku bank bid-only on merger plans.

text.p: Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd shares were bid-only in Wednesday morning trade, after it announced on Tuesday it would merge with Hokkaido Bank Ltd.
As of 0034 GMT, Hokkaido Takushoku shares were bid-only at 160 yen after closing at 153 yen on Monday. Hokkaido Bank stood at 185 yen after finishing at 163 on Monday.
Both shares were suspended from trade on Tuesday.
Brokers said that although the merger was between two weak banks, the banks' efforts to tackle their bad-loan problems was to be commended.
Hokkaido Takushoku said on Tuesday it would cease overseas operations and aim to make the merged entity a "super-regional" bank.
